newsitem.title: BRAZIL: RESEARCH ALERT-Telebras 12-mo price target raised.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT-Telebras 12-mo price target raised.

text.p: Merrill Lynch said it had raised its 12-month price target for Brazilian telecommunications firm Telebras to $200 per ADR.
-- also raised its 12-month price target for Telesp, Telebras' operator serving Sao Paulo state, to 445 reais per 1,000 shares.
-- also reiterated their buy ratings on Telebras and Telesp stocks.

-- The Merrill Lynch report follows this week's announcement of the winning group of a cellular phone concession in Sao Paulo metropolitan area. A consortium led by U.S. BellSouth Corp submitted the winning bid of 2.6 billion reais for the Sao Paulo area.
-- "The winning bid was 30 percent higher than our most optimistic estimate and 341 percent higher than the minimum bid price," Raymond E. Liguori and Meredith Prichard said in the report.

-- They said concern over price competition should abate as the consortium's weighted average tariff proposal is only 2.4 percent lower than Telesp's. "We expect BellSouth to compete based on network coverage and quality of service," they said.
-- Telebras preferred was off 1.73 percent at 170 reais on the Sao Paulo bolsa.
-- Telesp preferred was off 0.26 percent at 384 reais.
